The row maps to auto-fix, and the coder is the one to brief. But the coder isn't among the agents I'm allowed to contact; only the triage sorter, investigator, and reviewer are. So I can't hand this to the coder directly, and I need to work out how the auto-fix gets routed instead.

I'll go with auto-fix, since the coder can't be contacted directly and the code process handles the handoff. The reason will carry the cause and the file. Reviewer comes in after the fix, so it isn't part of this decision.

arguments.reason: The investigator found, with high confidence and in code, that OrderApi.GetOrderTotal (src/OrderService/Api/OrderTotal.cs, line 18) throws KeyNotFoundException on DiscountRates[order.DiscountCode] for order 1003, whose retired code SUMMER25 is not in the table. This matches the order-total Decisions row "a crash in this method's code, its cause certain, e.g. a KeyNotFoundException for a retired discount code" -> auto-fix (coder). The expected behaviour is that an unknown code gives no discount (total = subtotal), and totals for WELCOME10, VIP20 and no-code orders must not change.
